source.title: Hinterlands Mission XVIII: Rescue Veanna Cloudsleeper
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Veanna Cloudsleeper there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Veanna Cloudsleeper from the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion in the hammock above Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
